Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. with the appropriate authorities for all applicable statutory duties and taxes. The bidd er must have a registered office in the State of Kerala at the time of submission of the bid. 3. 3. Proof of Registered Office: The bidder shall upload valid documentary evidence establishing the existence of its registered office in Kerala. 4. 4. Relevant Experience: The bidder shall have experience in the supply and installa tion of similar-category products during the preceding three financial years (2023–24, 2024–25, and 2025–26) to Government organisations/PSUs in Kerala. 5. 5. Documentary Evidence of Experience: The bidder shall upload clear copies of t he relevant Work Orders/Purchase Orders along with the corresponding Completion C ertificates/Performance Certificates issued by the respective client organisations. The se documents shall clearly indicate the date of completion, value of work, and catego ry of products supplied, thereby establishing compliance with ATC Clause 4. Bids sub mitted without valid Work Orders/Purchase Orders and corresponding Completion Cer tificates/Performance Certificates as proof of the required experience shall be rejecte d during technical evaluation. 6. 6. Non-Blacklisting of OEM: The OEM/Bidder shall not have been declared ineligibl e for corrupt or fraudulent practices or blacklisted by any Central or State Governmen t agency. A self-declaration regarding non-blacklisting, duly issued on the Bidders lett erhead and signed by its authorised signatory, shall be submitted along with the bid. 7. 7. Scope of Price Bid: The quoted price shall be inclusive of both the supply and ins tallation of the equipment. 8. 8. OEM Authorisation: The bidder shall be an authorised partner of the OEM. The bi dder shall submit a Manufacturer Authorisation Form (MAF) issued by the OEM in the prescribed format, clearly mentioning the relevant bid number and date. The MAF sha ll be duly signed by the authorised signatory of the OEM and shall bear the OEM's offi cial seal. Unsigned or unsealed MAFs shall not be accepted. 9. 9. Local Support and Onsite Service: The bidder shall have a local support facility in Kerala and shall ensure that an onsite support engineer reaches the customer site within four (4) hours of fault reporting. The OEM shall also assign its own technical rep resentative to address critical issues and provide onsite support whenever required. D etails of the bidder's local office and the OEM's technical representative in Kerala shal l be furnished along with the bid. 10. 10. OEM Warranty Confirmation: The bidder shall submit a declaration from the O EM confirming that the warranty certificates for the supplied equipment shall be duly i ssued and validated by the OEM. Important: Failure to submit any of the documents or declarations specified above shall re nder the bid liable for rejection during technical evaluation. .
